blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: UK GDPR — Core UK personal-data legal framework.
DPA 2018 — UK Data Protection Act currently in force.
Computer Misuse Act — Law concerning unauthorised computer access/attacks.
copyright — Rights governing use of protected works.
RIPA — Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act 2000.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: Study the four Acts named in the H446 specification for exam terminology, but do not confuse the historical Data Protection Act 1998 with current law.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Current UK personal-data processing is principally governed by UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018, with later amendments. Lawful processing, fairness, transparency and data minimisation are key principles.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: The Computer Misuse Act concerns unauthorised computer access and attacks; copyright law protects qualifying creative works; RIPA addresses particular investigatory powers and safeguards, not a general licence for anyone to monitor communications.
